headline: Hurricane Isaias Approaches US Gulf Coast, Prompting Energy Shut-ins
summary: Hurricane Isaias approaches the US Gulf Coast, threatening significant disruptions to energy infrastructure and leading to production shut-ins.
why: Hurricanes in the US Gulf Coast frequently disrupt offshore oil and gas production, impacting short-term energy supplies and market prices.

impacts.name: Crude Oil
impacts.why: Production shut-ins from hurricanes restrict oil supply, typically pushing crude prices higher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The threat of production shut-ins from Hurricane Isaias reduces immediate energy supply expectations, driving potential upward price movement.
